verdict.rationale: A hands-on user report says Ollama can 'hotswap' models without restarting the server and uses different models per feature [ollama-comm-4]. First-party material backs this up: models are managed through a REST API [ollama-gh-4], multiple models can run concurrently [ollama-docs-17], models can be switched without changing workflow [ollama-docs-3], and a pulled model is immediately available [ollama-comm-5]. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how models are loaded and unloaded in memory, documented limits on concurrent loading, and clarity on whether the concurrency claim covers local serving or only the cloud tier.
